title: Physical Feasibility Engines — Accessibility + Workholding + Rigidity
description: Build the three core physical feasibility engines: AccessibilityAnalysisEngine (tool reach, holder clearance, corner radius, approach angle, chip evacuation), WorkholdingViabilityEngine (clamping surface tracking, grip degradation, vacuum/magnetic seal, datum integrity), RigidityDegradationEngine (wall/floor stiffness evolution, natural frequency, chatter onset, support strategies).

units.title: AccessibilityAnalysisEngine: tool reach, holder clearance, corner radius, approach angle, chip evacuation, 5-axis reachability
steps: Tool length check: tool_length ≥ feature_depth + clearance (5mm default) + holder_protrusion
Holder collision: OBB of holder assembly vs IPW walls using CollisionDetectionEngine
Corner radius: R_corner ≥ R_tool (smallest available tool from catalog)
Approach angle: feature normal vs available tool orientations (3-axis: Z only; 5-axis: cone)
Chip evacuation: pocket_depth / min_width ratio > 4 → warn (chips can't escape)
5-axis singularity: check via FiveAxisPostEngine.detectSingularities()
Undercut detection: features requiring approach from below horizontal plane
findReachableTools(): query 46,590-tool catalog for tools that CAN reach feature
checkAllFeatures(): batch check all features against IPW at current state
exit_conditions: Tool length check catches impossible reach
Holder collision detected for close-wall features
20+ tests covering all 7 geometry failure modes

units.title: WorkholdingViabilityEngine: surface tracking, grip degradation, vacuum seal, datum integrity
steps: Surface catalog from WorkpieceStateEngine.getSurfaces(): area, normal, flatness per surface
Clamping zone tracking: categorize surfaces into top/bottom/sides/bore by normal direction
Grip force model: F_grip = μ × clamp_pressure × A_remaining — degrades as surfaces shrink
Safety check: F_grip > F_cutting × safety_factor (2.0 default) at every stage
Vacuum fixture: track seal perimeter — through-holes break seal → flag
Magnetic fixture: surface area × flux density — minimum area threshold
Datum surface tracking: flag when probe reference surface will be destroyed by upcoming op
Re-fixturing check: after setup flip, are there parallel surfaces for new clamping?
Multi-part/tombstone: check fixture layout collision between parts
exit_conditions: Grip force degradation detected after surface removal
Vacuum seal break detected for through-hole operations
Datum surface destruction warned before it happens
Re-fixturing feasibility verified for multi-setup jobs

units.title: RigidityDegradationEngine: wall/floor stiffness evolution, natural frequency, chatter onset, support strategies
steps: Query WorkpieceStateEngine.getMinWallThickness() at each operation stage
Thin wall model: δ = F×H³/(3×E×I) where I = L×t³/12, t from IPW wall section
Thin floor model: δ = α×F×a²/(E×t³), plate bending coefficients by aspect ratio
Natural frequency: fn = (1/2π)×√(k/m) — k decreases as material removed, m decreases too
Wire ThinFloorVibrationEngine for resonance risk assessment
Chatter onset: stability lobes shift as workpiece stiffness decreases — recompute per stage
Residual stress model: asymmetric material removal → stress redistribution → warping risk
findCriticalFeatures(): rank all remaining features by stiffness (weakest first)
suggestMachiningOrder(): 'thick features first, thin walls last' with physics justification
recommendSupport(): spring passes, backing material, reduced DOC, wax fill strategy
exit_conditions: Natural frequency decreases as material removed
Chatter risk increases for thin features
Support strategies recommended for sub-1mm walls
